description: Create src/actions/ecocert.ts — the server actions layer. This file is the only place the UI calls Payload. It depends on FEAT-001 (collection slugs must exist in payload-types.ts before importing them). It is independent of FEAT-003 (UI wiring).
steps: Create src/actions/ecocert.ts. First line: 'use server'. Imports: getPayload from 'payload', cookies from 'next/headers', config from '@/payload.config'.
Define return type alias: type ActionResult<T = unknown> = Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: T; error?: string }>

Implement loginUser(email: string, password: string): call payload.login({ collection: 'users', data: { email, password }, overrideAccess: false }). Return { success: true, data: result.user } on success, { success: false, error: e.message } on catch.

Implement registerUser({ orgName, nit, sector, name, email, password, role }): (A) payload.create organizations, (B) payload.create users with role='administrator' and organization=org.id, (C) call loginUser and return its result. Wrap full function in try/catch.

Implement getCurrentUser(): build Headers from `const cs = await cookies(); const headers = new Headers({ cookie: cs.toString() })`, then `const { user } = await payload.auth({ headers })`, return { success: true, data: user ?? null }.
Implement getOrganizations(): payload.find({ collection: 'organizations', overrideAccess: false, limit: 100 }). Return { success: true, data: result.docs }.
Implement getUsers(orgId: string): payload.find({ collection: 'users', where: { organization: { equals: orgId } }, overrideAccess: false, limit: 200 }). Return docs.

Implement createNotification({ userId, type, message, reference? }): payload.create({ collection: 'notifications', data: { user: userId, type, message, reference, read: false }, overrideAccess: false }). Return result. Swallow errors (non-blocking).
Implement createAuditLog(table, recordId, action, detail, organizationId?, userId?): if userId missing, call getCurrentUser() to get it. payload.create audit-log doc. Swallow errors (non-blocking).
Implement getAspects(orgId): find aspects where organization equals orgId, overrideAccess: false, limit: 500. Return docs.

Implement createAspect(data): compute significance = (data.severity??0)*(data.frequency??0)*(data.scope??0). If any factor 0/missing, level='Pendiente' and call createNotification warning (RN-02). Else level = sig>=60?'Alta':sig>=27?'Media':'Baja' (RN-01). payload.create aspects with significance+level. Call createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement updateAspect(id, data): if severity/frequency/scope present, recalculate. payload.update. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getLegalRequirements(orgId): find legal-requirements for org. Return docs.
Implement createLegalRequirement(data): payload.create. createAuditLog. Return result.

Implement updateLegalRequirement(id, data): (A) payload.findByID existing doc. (B) if data.compliance==='No cumple' and existing.compliance!=='No cumple': payload.create non-conformity with status='Detectada' origin='Requisito legal' legalRequirement=id; createNotification to responsible user (RN-04). (C) payload.update. (D) createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getObjectives(orgId): find objectives for org. Return docs.
Implement createObjective(data): validate data.actions?.length >= 1 and each action has responsible+resources+deadline (RN-05); return error if not. payload.create. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement updateObjective(id, data): payload.update. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement addObjectiveProgress({ objectiveId, value, comment }): getCurrentUser for user id. payload.create objective-progress. payload.update objective currentValue. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getAudits(orgId): find audits for org. Return docs.
Implement createAudit(data): payload.create. createAuditLog. Return result.

Implement updateAudit(id, data): payload.update audits. Then for each finding in data.findings where isNonConformity===true (RN-08): determine status = criticality==='Crítica'?'Escalada':'Detectada'. payload.create non-conformity with that status and origin='Auditoría' and audit=id. If Crítica: find all users with role=senior_management in same org and call createNotification for each. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getNonConformities(orgId): find non-conformities for org. Return docs.
Implement createNonConformity(data): payload.create. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement updateNonConformity(id, data): payload.update. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getIncidents(orgId): find incidents for org. Return docs.
Implement createIncident(data): payload.create. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getTrainings(orgId): find trainings for org. Return docs.
Implement createTraining(data): payload.create. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getEvidences(orgId): find evidences for org. Return docs.
Implement createEvidence(data): payload.create. createAuditLog. Return result.
Implement getNotifications(userId): find notifications where user=userId, sort by createdAt desc. Return docs.
Implement markNotificationRead(id): payload.update notifications id with read=true. Return result.
Ensure every exported function has 'use server' (the file-level directive covers all). Double-check all payload.find/create/update calls have overrideAccess: false.
acceptance_criteria: Running `pnpm run generate:types 2>&1 | head -60` still completes without errors after the file is created
src/actions/ecocert.ts has 'use server' as its first line
All 31 exported functions are present and use overrideAccess: false
createAuditLog and createNotification swallow errors (wrapped in try/catch that does not rethrow)
updateLegalRequirement auto-creates a NonConformity when compliance changes to 'No cumple' (RN-04)
updateAudit auto-creates NonConformities for findings with isNonConformity=true, with Escalada status for Crítica findings (RN-08)
createAspect sets level='Pendiente' and creates a notification when any factor is missing (RN-02)

findings: TypeScript check passes with `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` (exit 0). `pnpm run generate:types` fails with FIGMA_EID error (platform env var, known environment limitation). All 31 exported functions are present with overrideAccess: false. createAuditLog/createNotification swallow errors. RN-01/02/04/05/08 all implemented. Notes for FEAT-003 (UI): (1) All action return types are ActionResult<unknown> — data field is `unknown`, UI must cast. (2) Key doc field names on returned objects: Aspect: {id, name, activity, impact, severity, frequency, scope, significance, level, organization, createdBy}. LegalRequirement: {id, title, issuer, aspect, nextReview, compliance, responsible, organization}. Objective: {id, title, indicator, target, currentValue, unit, deadline, owner, status, actions[{description,resources,deadline,completed,responsible}], organization}. Audit: {id, area, scope, criteria, date, auditor, status, findings[{description,criteria,criticality,isNonConformity,evidenceUrl}], organization}. NonConformity: {id, code, description, origin, criticality, status, rootCause, deadline, owner, audit, legalRequirement, correctiveAction{description,responsible,resources,deadline,effective}, closedAt, organization}. User: {id, name, email, role, organization, active, responsible}. Notification: {id, user, message, type, read, reference}. Incidents/Trainings/Evidences/AuditLog/ObjectiveProgress slugs require payload-types regeneration for full typing — currently accessed via 'as any' cast on the payload client.
